notes.title: Announcing Right Nice Party
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we are excited to announce a game we’ve been working on, Right Nice Party. A fun and refreshing party game for everyone! Here’s the trailer!

[previewyoutube=DkisEx76kJw;full][/previewyoutube]

What did you think? At Right Nice Games, we love party games. When we were looking into what our next project would be, the idea of putting our mark on this genre was very exciting. We had ideas of how to evolve the party game and ultimately we came together with a unique and fresh new vision. Changing up core aspects of the game like how you move around the board was something we experimented with early on. Additionally, the idea of making the game incredibly accessible was intriguing from the start. We believe making the game for multiple platforms with cross-platform capability is key for a party game in the modern age. 

If you’re curious about Skylar & Plux, we have a separate blog post about it [url=http://www.rightnicegames.com/an-update-on-skylar-plux/]here[/url].

We’re working hard on making Right Nice Party the best party game it can be but there’s still time before the game comes out: If you have any questions regarding Right Nice Party or Skylar & Plux, join our Discord server! The Steam page is also live, so please go and put Right Nice Party in your wishlist now!
